instructions: Check each entry against the archive text. Set verdict to agree, disagree or partial (some categories or links are right) and explain any disagreement in note. A negative entry claims the item has no category.

entries.text: Introductions and a shared meeting place. Hello Sol, I'm Moss. I'm going to collect some meadow roots south of here; I know roots provide food without toxicity. I'd enjoy getting acquainted. Have you found a good place to meet or rest?
entries.note: Agree: "I'd enjoy getting acquainted. Have you found a good place to meet or rest?" is a greeting and a question to sol; it names no place or time and proposes no specific joint activity.

entries.text: Hello, I'm Kai. I know the red berries are safe food. I'll gather a modest supply and leave some for others. I'd welcome sharing food knowledge and working out fair use of nearby resources.
entries.note: Agree: "I'll gather a modest supply and leave some for others" is a personal plan, not a general norm; no category applies.

entries.text: The Redberry Pause
entries.note: The round-3 named event records that sol named this place "The Redberry Pause" (sign-3-sol-26, subject place:13,16), a proper name rather than a description.

entries.text: The pressed sample left a visible mark on the forest floor (contrast 0.14). 0.6 is reserved for drawing. Durability untested.
entries.note: Agree: "The pressed sample left a visible mark on the forest floor (contrast 0.14)" is the mechanical test report for mark-11-sol-117 and states no valuation.

entries.text: A small neighborly pause: introductions, food knowledge, and ideas for something we could make together. All welcome.
entries.evidence: A small neighborly pause: introductions, food knowledge, and ideas for something we could make together. All welcome.
entries.note: The round-12 invited event "Moss invited listeners to meet at (14.99, 17.7) at round 18", heard by lin, sol, kai and ivo, is a concrete place-and-time invitation.

entries.text: I have ten roots in reserve; I tested eating roots and know they provide nutrition without toxicity. Kai told me red berries are safe. I'd enjoy hearing what each of you likes doing, or helping with a small shared drawing.
entries.note: Agree, though close: "I'd enjoy hearing what each of you likes doing, or helping with a small shared drawing" is a hypothetical offer with no concrete activity, place or time; kai, whom it mentions, heard it and was present.

entries.text: Moss, I'd like to join your pause. I'm Sol. I've tested a little berry colour on the forest floor at The Redberry Pause; it left a visible muted rose mark. I'm trying a tiny branching drawing there.
entries.evidence: it left a visible muted rose mark. I'm trying a tiny branching drawing there.
entries.note: Close: "it left a visible muted rose mark. I'm trying a tiny branching drawing there" describes a colour and a planned drawing but expresses no liking or meaning for them, so no valuation is stated in the text.

entries.text: I'm Kai. I'd like to join your pause after a short rest. I've eaten red berries safely and have four left. I like the idea of making something together, with everyone free to contribute or simply watch.
entries.evidence: with everyone free to contribute or simply watch
details: new norm R1 "Everyone is free to contribute or simply watch shared making."
entries.note: "with everyone free to contribute or simply watch" states a shared expectation for the group's making, not a personal plan; lin, moss, sol and wren heard it in round 18.

entries.text: I'm Lin. I enjoy exploring at my own pace. One bare-hand squeeze left a hazelnut intact; its contents and food safety are still unknown to me. Next I'll investigate a stone as a possible opening tool. What do you enjoy making?
entries.note: Agree: "I enjoy exploring at my own pace ... What do you enjoy making?" is an introduction, a trial report and a question; no category applies.

entries.text: I'm Wren. Roots have safely fed me; I have five in reserve before my next meal. I'm investigating hazelnuts, but have not established their safety. I enjoy careful practical experiments and would welcome comparing findings.
entries.note: Agree: "I enjoy careful practical experiments and would welcome comparing findings" is a general wish to exchange information, not a concrete invitation; no category applies.

entries.text: I like the thought of making something small together. Berries gave my test mark a muted rose colour, though I haven't tested durability. What materials or places have caught your eye?
entries.evidence: Berries gave my test mark a muted rose colour
entries.note: "Berries gave my test mark a muted rose colour, though I haven't tested durability" only reports a colour, and "I like the thought of making something small together" values an activity, not an object.

entries.text: Sol, your berry colour interests me. I'd like to try a tiny root sample here to compare materials, then add a small branching shape if it marks. I like making places where people can contribute or simply sit together.
entries.evidence: Sol, your berry colour interests me.
entries.note: Close: "Sol, your berry colour interests me" values the colour of Sol's berry mark (mark-11-sol-117, described by sol in rounds 16 and 23 and heard by moss), although the sentence goes on to compare materials.

entries.text: The little berry drawing now has three visible strokes meeting in a branch on the forest floor at The Redberry Pause. Its durability is untested. I'm happy to sit together; anyone may add an idea or simply watch.
entries.evidence: The little berry drawing now has three visible strokes meeting in a branch on the forest floor at The Redberry Pause. Its durability is untested. I'm happy to sit together; anyone may add an idea or simply watch.
